name: focus-blocker
description: A small Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that blocks distracting websites, with a per-site on/off switch.

scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && zip -r dist/focus-blocker.zip manifest.json background.js shared.js popup.html popup.js popup.css blocked.html blocked.js blocked.css icons -x '*.DS_Store'

author: Tim Vu
